_note: Tier 2 merges for delegate designation and institution, decided one cluster at a time by the conference owner on 2026-09-04. Every line here is a human call, NOT a similarity score -- the script that applies it does no matching of its own. That separation exists because 'Kasturba Nursing College, Sevagram' (47 delegates) and 'Kasturba Nursing School, Sevagram' (8) are different institutions one word apart, and any rule loose enough to catch the MGIMS spellings also merges those two.
